parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture, and here both records are test methods (`PlaylistAPIVersionTests.invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` at line 108 and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` at line 122).
